name: toss-invest-mcp
description: MCP server for the Toss Securities Open API: read-only Korean/US market-data tools (always on) plus order/account tools (off by default, dry-run until explicitly enabled). Requires a one-time build with JDK 21 after install — see docs/install-plugins.md.

toss_client_id.title: Toss client ID
toss_client_id.description: Toss Securities Open API client ID, issued at openapi.tossinvest.com.

toss_client_secret.title: Toss client secret
toss_client_secret.description: Toss Securities Open API client secret, issued at openapi.tossinvest.com.

toss_account.title: Toss account number
toss_account.description: Account serial number. Required only for the order/account tools (placeOrder, cancelOrder, getOpenOrders, getHoldings, getBuyingPower). Leave blank if you only use the market-data tools.
